pmid_or_source: UniProt Q6IQ32 Q9H2P0 P02833; 240 human homeodomains
claim_tested: ADNP2 helix 3 retains WFxNxR and base-contacting positions 47, 50, 51, 54
key_finding: Helix 3 is FFGKRR. 0 of 6 literature base-contact consensus matches versus background 3.81 +/- 1.50. Contact-surface log-odds -8.2 versus 30.4 +/- 13.1 (z -2.94, 2.1st percentile). ADNP scores 1 of 6 and +2.6 (6.7th percentile).
organism_tissue_assay: human protein sequence; canonical numbering anchored on Antennapedia
limitations: Residual register risk for ADNP2 since its 60-mer comes from the UniProt boundary rather than an HMM match. Controls behave as expected: EN2 6/6 at 76th pct, HOXB13 and PITX2 4/6, POU5F1 3/6, CUX1 2/6.

citation: This work: contacts measured from DNA-bound structures
claim_tested: The base-contacting positions are 47, 50, 51, 54 and ADNP2 keeps them
key_finding: At a 4.0 Angstrom cutoff the base-contact positions are 5 (66% of chains), 47 (74%), 50 (57%), 51 (77%); position 54 reaches 26% and position 3 passes neither threshold. ADNP2 fails all four at 0 of 4 with log-odds -13.0, the lowest of 240 human homeodomains (background 12.2 +/- 5.8, z -4.31).
organism_tissue_assay: crystal and NMR homeodomain-DNA complexes; fly, yeast, human, mouse factors
limitations: Entry set is not exhaustive and over-represents Antp-class and POU-class domains. Position 3 is unresolved in several entries so no claim is made about it.

citation: This work: superposition onto the Antennapedia-DNA complex
claim_tested: The degenerate surface means ADNP2 cannot approach DNA
key_finding: CA RMSD 2.36 Angstrom over canonical 7-57 (51 atoms). The recognition helix lands in the major groove: position 47 at 3.9 A from base atoms, position 51 at 3.5 A. 10 Lys or Arg within 8 A of DNA versus 12 for Antennapedia. Gln50 becomes glycine and Asn51 becomes lysine.
organism_tissue_assay: rigid-body placement, no refinement, no DNA in the predicted model
limitations: The N-terminal arm distances (positions 5, 6, 8 at 15 to 21 A) come from an apo prediction of a flexible segment and are not evidence.

pmid_or_source: UniProt ZN_FING features Q6IQ32 Q9H2P0; 3566 fingers from 400 reviewed human PF00096 proteins
claim_tested: The zinc fingers can carry DNA binding in place of the homeodomain, and ADNP2 has nine intact fingers
key_finding: 4 of 9 ADNP2 fingers match C-x(2,4)-C-x(12)-H-x(3,5)-H, identical to ADNP. Both at the 0.8th percentile of the human C2H2 distribution (0.933 +/- 0.114, z -4.28). Recognition-position chemistry at -1, +2, +3, +6 is ordinary in both (ADNP2 0.625, ADNP 0.639 versus 0.738 +/- 0.219, both 28.9th percentile; Mann-Whitney one-sided p 0.073 and 0.085). Neither carries Pfam PF00096; PROSITE PS50157 matches one finger each.
organism_tissue_assay: human protein sequence; UniProt feature intervals; InterPro precomputed matches
limitations: Pattern matching and composition with no binding measurement. Background is the first 400 of 681 reviewed human PF00096 proteins. The conclusion that the fingers do not separate the paralogs is firmer than any conclusion about whether they bind.

claim_tested: The homeodomain signature support for ADNP2 equals that for ADNP
key_finding: Q6IQ32 has only SMART SM00389, CDD cd00086 and SUPERFAMILY SSF46689 over the homeodomain; no Pfam PF00046, no PROSITE PS50071, no CATH-Gene3D 1.10.10.60. Q9H2P0 has all six. ADNP2 is absent from the reviewed human PF00046 set; ADNP is present.
limitations: Absence of a match reflects each model's gathering threshold, not absence of homology.

claim_tested: GO:0003677 for ADNP2 has experimental support
key_finding: GO:0003677 is IEA, ECO:0000256, GO_REF:0000002, from InterPro. No experimental molecular-function annotation except GO:0005515 (IPI, IntAct).

Mean pLDDT 85.3 with 90% of residues above 70 against a whole-chain mean of 56.9. Three helices in canonical register. Contact residues S47, F48, G50, K51 modelled at pLDDT 86-92. All nine zinc fingers modelled at mean pLDDT 81.6 to 91.5.
limitations: AlphaFold predicts a fold, not a binding activity.

pmid_or_source: 52 ADNP2 and 68 ADNP ortholog entries, UniProt
claim_tested: The degenerate residues are a human idiosyncrasy or a sequencing artifact
key_finding: ADNP2: F48 100%, G50 98%, S47 96%, K51 92%, E5 81% across species to turkey, Komodo dragon and caecilian. ADNP: G3, E5, I31, S47, H48, S50, N51, R53, K54, K55 each 100%.
limitations: Many entries are automatic gene-model predictions, so individual species calls can be wrong; the aggregate frequency is not.

claim_tested: ADNP2 reaches chromatin by sequence-specific DNA binding
key_finding: ChAHP2 (ADNP2, CHD4, HP1) is targeted to ERVs and LINEs via HP1-beta binding of H3K9 trimethylated histones. Genetic ablation of ADNP2 de-represses ERVs and LINE1.
limitations: Does not test the isolated homeodomain and does not exclude a secondary DNA contact.

claim_tested: DNA motif recognition is a family property
key_finding: ADNP, not ADNP2, recognises DNA motifs that specify binding of ChAHP to euchromatin.
limitations: Shows the paralogs differ. The domain responsible in ADNP is not resolved.

claim_tested: The homeodomain is the DNA-binding module in this family
key_finding: ChAHP is described as a distinct zinc-finger protein complex that competes with CTCF for a shared motif set.
limitations: Attribution to zinc fingers is by family reasoning plus function, not by domain-deletion mapping.

claim_tested: The ADNP2 homeobox call is independent evidence
key_finding: ADNP2 was identified as a homeobox-profile containing gene in a screen for homologous proteins to ADNP.
limitations: Confirms the homeobox label is a profile match, not a measured activity.

key_finding: ADNP and its homologue ADNP2 belong to a homeodomain, the zinc finger-containing protein family.
limitations: A family assignment, not a binding assay. The functional work is on erythroid maturation and ADNP binding to the beta-globin locus control region.
